What Is MCP and Why Kiro Uses It

This protocol is why Kiro can talk to almost any tool.
MCP — Model Context Protocol — connects Kiro to external tools and data.
It's an open standard, not a Kiro-only trick.
That's how one IDE reaches dozens of real-world services.

Episode 56 of theAIgurukul's free Kiro series, a daily short on AWS's agentic IDE. Subscribe for the next one.
